mapper.select: SELECT eventseq, event_subject, event_startdate, event_enddate, event_drawingdate, event_image_org_filename, event_image_filename, event_contents, event_total_winners FROM tbl_event WHERE eventseq = #{eventseq}

SELECT A.entryseq, A.fk_eventseq, A.fk_userseq, A.fk_recipeseq, A.chk_win, B.nickname, B.profile_sysfilename, C.r_subject, C.r_imgname FROM tbl_entry A JOIN tbl_user B ON A.fk_userseq = B.userseq JOIN tbl_recipe C ON A.fk_recipeseq = C.recipeseq WHERE A.fk_eventseq = #{eventseq} ORDER BY A.entryseq DESC
